system.description:
No subtle trick, Psychic Assault is a hammer that splits a mind in half — the only outward sign is the victim's agony and a nosebleed. Mortals it kills seem to die of a heart attack; vampires crumble instantly to dust, whatever their age.

Spend two Blood Traits and either touch the victim (a Physical Challenge may be required) or lock eyes; assaulting a vampire or other supernatural also costs a Willpower Trait. Declare your intent in advance — it cannot be changed. To frighten: win one Mental Challenge; the victim is wracked for two turns, loses two temporary Willpower, and bids an extra Trait all night (Kindred test against Rötschreck). To knock out: win two Mental Challenges; the victim sleeps an hour and wakes with three lethal levels, losing two temporary and one permanent Willpower (one win only inflicts a headache — two bashing). To kill: win three Mental Challenges. Failing every challenge on a knockout or kill attempt makes the target immune for the rest of the night; losing your last Willpower to it renders you unconscious for the evening.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits (plus one Willpower Trait vs. supernaturals)
system.duration: Two turns to instant, per declared effect
